results.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
excerpts:
# Claude Opus 5.5
We’re introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family. It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.

...

Because Opus 5.5 is comparable to Claude Mythos 5.1 in biology and cybersecurity, we’re deploying it with safeguards similar to those on Claude Fable 5.1. Vetted organizations can apply today to our [Life Sciences Verification Program](https://www.anthropic.com/news/life-sciences-verification-program) to use Opus 5.5 for biology research.
In the coming weeks we will also be expanding access to our [Cyber Verification Program](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842-real-time-cyber-safeguards-on-claude-opus-and-sonnet) , and verified cybersecurity practitioners will be able to use Opus 5.5 for their work.

...

## Safety
### Safeguards
For cyberdefenders, we’ll soon be expanding our [Cyber Verification Program](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842-real-time-cyber-safeguards-on-claude-opus-and-sonnet) to include Opus 5.5. The new program will include three tiers for increasingly permissive trusted access, including access to Claude Mythos models. [Claude Security](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-code-security) is already available with access to Claude Mythos 5.1.
For this reason, Opus 5.5 uses the same biology safeguards as Fable 5.1. To use Opus 5.5 for research and development work impeded by these safeguards, users can apply to our new [Life Sciences Verification Program](https://www.anthropic.com/news/life-sciences-verification-program) , which gives vetted organizations like academic labs, startups, and pharmaceutical companies access to safeguards designed for the full breadth of biology-related work.

## Availability
Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. On the Claude Platform, developers can [get started](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview) with `claude-opus-5-5` . See our [migration guide for details.](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/migration-guide)

results.title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
excerpts:
# Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
We plan to make Astra available soon, but access to its most advanced cybersecurity capabilities will be more limited. Advanced cybersecurity work will initially be available to a group of testers, with access through Daybreak Blue following to expand defensive use.
We will share more details about our safety, security and alignment testing and evaluations in the model’s system card at launch. Ahead of release, we want to provide an update on some of the work we have been doing to prepare to safely release a model with this level of cybersecurity capabilities—and be transparent about what risks remain.

## Assessing Astra’s cybersecurity capabilities
_Astra results shown reflect capabilities with Daybreak Blue access, not the default production configuration._

...

Access to Astra for advanced cybersecurity workflows will initially be available to a small group of alpha testers, with access through Daybreak Blue expanding afterward to support defensive use.

# Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
## Alignment & monitoring
While GPT‑5.6 Sol indicated higher likelihood for cheating in these scenarios, Astra did not attempt to use those shortcuts, and it was still able to legitimately solve some tasks._

...

## What this will mean for users
If the misalignment monitor pauses a task, users in ChatGPT or Codex may be asked to review the action before continuing. When using other surfaces like the API, the task will stop. We plan to keep calibrating these safeguards to reduce unnecessary interruptions and expand access to frontier capabilities through programs like Daybreak.

excerpts:
# OpenAI Daybreak - Common Issues and Troubleshooting
Troubleshoot individual account-security requirements, verification, API project controls, model access, and cyber safety messages for OpenAI Daybreak.
Updated: 6 hours ago

# Overview
Daybreak Access is OpenAI’s Trusted Access for Cyber program. Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red are access tiers within Daybreak levels. This article covers individual account-security requirements, verification, workspace and API project controls, model access, legacy GPT-5.5-Cyber access, and unexpected cyber safety messages.

...

* If you are approved for Daybreak as an individual, you have checked Your eligibility at [chatgpt.com/cyber](https://chatgpt.com/cyber) , including your plan, Advanced Account Security, hardware security keys, and identity-verification status.
* You are using the approved OpenAI organization or workspace and the intended API project.
* For legacy GPT-5.5-Cyber access, you are using the exact model name gpt-5.5-cyber-preview.

# Verification issues
## If you received a Daybreak Blue reverification email
We corrected a technical issue in our verification process and removed access from affected individual Daybreak Blue accounts. This was our error, and we're sorry for the disruption.

# Daybreak model and project access issues
The available project controls depend on organization eligibility:
* Daybreak Blue appears for organizations eligible for Daybreak Blue or Daybreak Red.
* Daybreak Red appears only for organizations eligible for Daybreak Red.

...

## Contacting Support
If you still cannot complete verification, access Daybreak Blue, Daybreak Red, or legacy GPT-5.5-Cyber, or resolve a cyber safety message after working through the steps above, contact Support and include as much of the following as you can:

...

# FAQ
## Is Daybreak available through AWS Bedrock, Azure, or another cloud provider?
Daybreak is available via AWS Bedrock, though it still requires OpenAI approval via the standard Daybreak route - reach out to your AWS account team for access.
